findings.title: Bind routines responses to their initiating item
findings.suggested_fix: For options, build, and revise, capture a target item plus an immutable request-context/revision identifier before await. Apply the response only to that still-existing, unchanged target, and render or move steps only if it remains the selected item. Invalidate pending operations on deletion or replacement and prevent duplicate generation for the same revision. Add deferred-provider VM tests covering switch, deletion, and a second operation.

findings.title: Isolate new demo tools from personal workspaces
findings.suggested_fix: Use fresh per-instance in-memory storage for both new interfaces only when all three existing demo gates hold (demolab=1, embedded, administrator). Route every workspace read and save through that selected storage; prevent routines' Studio import from reading the ordinary private Studio record in demo mode. Keep ordinary persistence unchanged. Add actual-recipe success and provider-failure VM tests seeded with private forms, plans, people/families, procedure data, and history, asserting zero ordinary storage access and no private content in requests or captures.

findings.title: Keep practice demos away from saved personal cases
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the existing three-gate fresh in-memory demo storage pattern to the new private cases and draft state in practice.html. Scope the ordinary practice recipe's selection to the catalogue container as an additional explicit boundary. Exercise both actual practice recipes with a saved synthetic private case and draft, asserting the catalogue recipe never selects or sends the private character and the own-case recipe neither reads, writes, clears, nor evicts private records.

findings.title: Bind pending routine generation to its originating item
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the originating item and a per-item request generation before each asynchronous options, build and revision request. Apply returned data only to that captured item if it is still present and that generation is current; persist S, and redraw or change steps only when I is still the originating item. Do not write a completed request into the currently selected global I or resurrect an item deleted while pending.

findings.title: Demo runs overwrite private work and evict saved cases
findings.suggested_fix: Before any workspace read in family-bridge-ui.js, routines-ui.js and the practice own-case IIFE, select fresh memory storage only when demolab=1, the page is embedded and homeUrl is admin.html?role=sys; route every workspace read/write, including the routines Studio import, through it. findings.title: Switching routines sends a pending result into another item
findings.suggested_fix: Capture an item identity/reference and an operation or revision token before each options/build/revise await. Apply the result only to that initiating item if it still exists and the token is current, and redraw/navigate only when that item is still selected. Invalidate outstanding operations when an item is deleted or regenerated; do not let an older request unlock or update a newer request's controls. Verify deferred-provider sequences for A-to-B switching and deleting A, including preservation of B's existing plan, people and history.

findings.title: Pending routines generation overwrites another mechanism
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the target item and a request generation identifier before awaiting in options, build, and revise. Apply results only to that retained item if it still exists and the request is current, and redraw only when it remains selected. Add a DOM/VM regression test that holds A's response, selects B with existing plan/history, resolves A, and asserts B remains unchanged and A receives its own result; also cover deletion while pending.

residual_risks: Targeted execution of six test files produced 22 passing pure model/VM tests and 31 immediate fetch failed errors in loopback HTTP tests under the current sandbox. Actual listener assertions were inspected but transport behavior could not be independently executed here; no provider/live API or browser was used.
testing_gaps: harness/lib/studio.mjs:433 handles both 413 workflow exhaustion and 429 reservation denial by retaining an unready kit. The tests verify 413 after validation repair and 429 at root admission, but not 429 at the optional customer child. Add an actual-listener case with daily allowance sufficient for the root but insufficient for customer review, asserting one physical fetch, valid retained activity, customerReview.ready=false, no replacement fetch, and committed root with no occupied child reservation.

findings.title: Preserve retrieval and cancellation of legacy private jobs
findings.suggested_fix: Separate new-request admission from stored-job authorization. Keep mandatory page/permission declarations for admission; for legacy job records without either field, apply the former endpoint-specific live permission policy after the existing owner and tenant checks, only on status/cancel operations. Add a base-shaped persisted pipeline job recovery and cancellation regression test.

findings.title: Invalidate custom-case work when leaving the editor
findings.suggested_fix: Use an editor session generation and per-operation request ID; invalidate the session on cancel, scenario selection and approval. After await discard invalidated results and only call step when the request still belongs to the active editor session; retain the user's draft independently.
